title: How to ship hotfixes over-the-air with React Native | Brandon Mathis posted on the topic | LinkedIn

[](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mathisbrandon?trk=public_post_feed-actor-image)

🚨 App Store Reviewers HATE this one trick 🚨 Over-the-air update are simple for React Native apps! Earlier this year, I helped a small company called Skylight Social ship a TikTok competitor built with React Native on Bluesky's ATProtocol It can take up to 3 days to get a release approved for a mobile app but we shipped out hotfixes over-the-air using Expo Updates. If you are using React Native you HAVE to check this tool out [#reactnative](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Freactnative&trk=public_post-text) [#mobile](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fmobile&trk=public_post-text) [#react](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Freact&trk=public_post-text) [#javascript](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fjavascript&trk=public_post-text) [#expo](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fexpo&trk=public_post-text)

##### **Transcript**

You want to know React Native Pro tip? You can use Expo updates to skip the App Store release process. When my team was helping to build Skylight Social, we were sending changes out to the application every single day. Integrating Expo updates into your existing Expo application is really simple. Start by installing the Expo updates package, then run the command EAS update configure and you're done. Here's a pull request to the changes that we made. Just some modifications to our app dot JSON and then some changes to our EAS dot JSON. Specifically, the introduction of some new release channels for development, review and our production builds. After that, it's just the typical package dot JSON changes. Now that that change has been merged in, we could use the Expo update utility to start shipping out changes to our live production application. Just run the command eras update, give it the name of the release channel, and then a brief message of what these changes will be. From there, EAS will take over and this part will be simple. And just like that, our changes are live.

Been posting videos like this for fellow coders regularly on Skylight, TikTok, Bluesky and X. Linktree is in my LinkedIn contact info ℹ️

Great job man!
